providerSelection.behavior: An explicitly requested configured provider wins; otherwise configured OpenAI wins, then configured Gemini, then local.

controlPlane.finding: One route currently owns V1 intent/plans/typed commands, V2 reasoning, approval execution, provider invocation, response composition, and lifecycle projection. Both V1 and V2 execution paths are active.

agentV1.finding: Still authoritative whenever V2 primary mode is disabled and as deterministic/fact fallback while V2 is active.

agentV2Session.finding: Server-side session snapshots, bounded turns, pending-plan files, and JSONL session events are persisted. Timestamp bootstrap/server-wins conflict logic is active but is not yet a Planner V2 task authority.

agentV2Tools.finding: Registry adapters call existing Search, Results, Backtest, Paper, strategy, settings, workspace, and lifecycle services. Write tools are policy classified, validated, audited, and executed through the registry. Tool events are process-memory only.

agentV2Reasoning.finding: Primary/shadow mode, provider timeout, validation fallback, in-flight turn dedupe, approval fast path, canonical search hashes, cancel-replace planning, and primary-text sanitizer exist. Persisted reports prove browser and language acceptance remain incomplete.

clientAgent.finding: Global shared drawer/session UI is active across lifecycle pages. Client pending action state remains able to influence requests and therefore must be reconciled against server authority.

searchEngine.finding: Existing job store, runner, ownership audit, pause/cancel/resume, results, promotion, research loop, and evaluation policies remain the authoritative engine state machine.

backtestEngine.finding: Existing run service/store and metrics pipeline remain authoritative and are used by the tool adapter.

paperEngine.finding: Canonical Paper session service/store and executor gate remain authoritative. Agent tool coverage currently prepares only; it does not activate Paper.

liveEngine.finding: Existing Live engine remains outside Agent execution. Direct Live, real-order, and SAFE mutation intents are locally blocked before planning.

browserHarnesses.finding: Existing V2 final harness reuses one stateful production server and fixed ports across viewports. Its browser records do not implement the required isolated runtime lifecycle or complete machine-verifiable field set.

persistedReports.finding: Historical reports conflict. The newest dedicated final V2 report says NOT VERIFIED and skipped quality gates; older reports claim narrower success. No previous completion claim is accepted as current evidence.

plannerV2.finding: Required directory and versioned PlanV2 authority do not exist. Some draft/hash/diff helpers exist inside reasoning and V1 modules only.

tasksApprovalOrchestration.finding: Required task authority, approval invalidation, dependency ordering, restart reconciliation, and multi-tab conflict model do not yet exist as focused modules.

researchBrain.finding: Required dedicated evidence/gap/failure/comparison/recommendation/validation/audit modules do not exist. V1 researchWorkspace is a summary builder only.

eventLifecycle.finding: Tool events are in-memory; the required persisted, replayable cross-engine event layer and autonomous reconciliation are absent.

memoryReflection.finding: No server-authoritative bounded long-term decision/outcome memory or post-outcome reflection subsystem exists.

deadModules.finding: No module was proven dead strongly enough to remove during this audit; preservation rules forbid speculative cleanup.

fallbackModules.finding: These remain active deterministic/provider or V1 response fallbacks and cannot be classified as dead.

verifiedBlockers.evidence: tmp/agent-v2-final-verification.mjs uses fixed ports and one runtime/server for the browser matrix.
Newest browser report timed out at 390 during cancel-replace and reused ETH/running state at other viewports.
Client-provided pending action is accepted into entity memory; historical Conversation E reused an already prepared proposal and produced inconsistent approval prose.
Route approval fast path sets skipProvider and unit test AgentV2ApprovalFastPath passes, but the required isolated browser/provider audit proof is missing.
Historical live report contains primary prose with 15m, pending_approval, and exchangeCalled=false; fallback plan prose still embeds raw enum text in source.
Persisted provider responses include English pattern names, strategy IDs, 15m, and report-like wording.
Bounded provider calls and deterministic fallback exist and unit tests pass; historical provider health and fallback evidence conflict and are not a current clean-runtime proof.

Existing browserMatrix records only answer/approval/rawLeak fields and conflates before-approval and after-execution evidence; required persistedStateMatch, thinkingCleared, duplicateExecutionCount, overflow, and console fields are absent.
Newest report has 390 cancel-replace timeout, 1440 navigation timeout, incomplete E proof, skipped quality gates, and NOT VERIFIED verdict.
Planner/task/orchestration, dedicated Research Brain, persisted lifecycle events, long-term memory/reflection, and expanded safe tool coverage are absent.

nextGate: Finalize isolated Agent V2 Phase 3 acceptance before beginning Planner V2.
